scope: Expanded FEAT-028–031, ADR-004, CONTRACT-067–074, US/TD/STP-080–088, typed-persistence-design and Weft handoff, against core and CONTRACT-900–904

findings.issue: Action identity lacks complete declaration pin and issued revision
findings.location: CONTRACT-068 Actions; CONTRACT-069 Actions; CONTRACT-901 Revision and deployment
findings.counterexample: Redeploy the same module/action ID with changed effects; an old client selects the new meaning.
findings.proposedRepair: Pin original full declaration bytes and resolve through trusted registration to exact issued RevisionRef.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: SDK loses complete original tx/1 result
findings.location: CONTRACT-072 Outcomes; CONTRACT-068 Actions; CONTRACT-900 Executor obligations
findings.counterexample: Committed drops changes/noOp/verification and Conflict drops its code; reserved ENTITY_MISSING is outside the generated Literal union.
findings.proposedRepair: Preserve complete original result and protected-safe codes, with typed convenience accessors and exact receipt profile.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Bulk control API omits original attempt custody and recovery
findings.location: CONTRACT-072 Bulk plans; CONTRACT-069 Bulk; CONTRACT-904 control protocol
findings.counterexample: Submit commits but acknowledgement disappears before a job reference is returned.
findings.proposedRepair: Retain complete control unions, submit key, original host-issued attempt capability and protected recovery reference.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Raw native frame and authorization obligations are incomplete
findings.location: CONTRACT-073 Obligations by platform; CONTRACT-072 verification; CONTRACT-900 frame; CONTRACT-901 roles/1
findings.counterexample: DELETE cascades outside the frame; service current_user membership silently substitutes for roles/1 authenticated-human membership.
findings.proposedRepair: Admit and fence complete native dependency/side-effect closure; refuse human-role profile on service sessions.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Commit reconciliation lacks original store/incarnation custody
findings.location: CONTRACT-073 Commit-loss reconciliation and receipt row
findings.counterexample: Reconnect reaches a different or restored cluster where the same xid has unrelated committed status.
findings.proposedRepair: Verify original writer/store/incarnation continuity before status; otherwise indeterminate; known abort alone is not a concurrency conflict.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Continuation omits full ordering tuple and query binding
findings.location: CONTRACT-072 Continuations; CONTRACT-071 generated functions; Weft requirements S7
findings.counterexample: Paging amount DESC,id ASC cannot resume from id alone; another filter accepts the same cursor.
findings.proposedRepair: Carry all sort values, hidden transport descriptors, catalog/query/variant/parameter and target identity.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Raw atomic and frozen-manifest command profiles/carriers are conflated
findings.location: CONTRACT-071 Build tool/Catalog entries; CONTRACT-073 Bulk; TD-086; CONTRACT-902
findings.counterexample: A frozen/batch Plan is reselected and executed as one atomic set update; selection-only digest misses a changed update program.
findings.proposedRepair: Separate versioned execution artifacts/profiles; owner-prepared action binding; Weft-owned complete parameter-hole/digest scheme.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Async search hydration can violate original filter
findings.counterexample: Stale tenant-A candidate now belongs to tenant B and unfiltered get returns it.
findings.proposedRepair: Reapply original predicate in bounded hydration under current admission; count/drop stale nonmatches and qualify shortfall semantics.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Key selection is ambiguous and nested absence rules contradict
findings.location: CONTRACT-067 request/closure; CONTRACT-068 Keys; CONTRACT-070 RecordView/Conflict rules
findings.counterexample: Multiple Keys have one RecordKey with no choice; nullable unbound item requires both missing=true and missing=false.
findings.proposedRepair: Select explicit query Key; use exact referenced Key DTOs or refuse; define nested occurrence presence alternatives.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Optional null comparison semantics are not executable as specified
findings.location: CONTRACT-071 helper/variant/runtime rules; Weft requirements S2
findings.counterexample: Present nullable parameter binds None to column=:p, producing UNKNOWN although helper prose promises IS NULL.
findings.proposedRepair: Choose SQL equality plus explicit null tests or explicit null-sensitive lowering/variant policy; test all three states.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

findings.issue: Writer ownership and search execution artifacts are incomplete
findings.location: CONTRACT-067 Host writer; CONTRACT-071 stage ownership/artifacts; CONTRACT-074 fusion/hydration
findings.counterexample: Stage-one replacement loses ignored stage-two paths; concurrent writers race; one SQL artifact lacks hybrid legs/hydration.
findings.proposedRepair: Preserve stage ownership with serialized recoverable publication and stale checks; define bounded search-program artifact.
findings.disposition: accepted; correction in progress; focused rereview pending

Raw/replaying capabilities and target-specific qualification are separated.

Weft owns exact command/search artifacts, security inputs and structural digest corpus.
Truss read adoption precedes qualified gateway/control and manifest composition.
Raw action admission/outcome/receipt foundation precedes raw bulk.

Propagate every correction through FEAT/US/TD/STP and pin cross-repository dependencies.

Explicitly deferred native witnesses, typing spike, release arrangements and spending ceiling are not themselves defects.
